item.description:
### For organisation-managed Macs
- Apps your organisation blocks are now blocked on this Mac, and their websites too — blocking Discord also blocks discord.com. - Blocks your organisation schedules apply only during their set hours, and start and stop right on time. - See what your organisation blocks: under Always Block and Custom Schedule in Blocker, and in the active list on Home. Tap one to see every app and website it covers.
### Smaller fixes
- "1 app" and "1 site" now read correctly. - The Habits icon for laptop-free time shows on macOS 14.
